title: How to Care for Suede Shoes
excerpt: Suede looks beautiful and is easy to look after. A few simple steps keep your shoes looking new.
body:
Suede is soft and gentle, so it needs a little care.

Step 1: Brush it. Use a soft suede brush after every wear to lift dust and dirt.

Step 2: Remove marks. Rub small marks with a suede eraser. Never use water on stains.

Step 3: Protect it. Use a suede protector spray before the first wear.

Step 4: Store it well. Keep your shoes in a dust bag, away from sun and damp.

With these four steps your suede shoes will look fresh for years.

title: Stiletto or Block Heel: Which One Is Right for You?
excerpt: A simple guide to help you choose the right heel for the right event.
body:
Stiletto heels are slim and elegant. They make your legs look longer and suit night parties and weddings.

Block heels are wide and stable. They are better for long hours of standing and walking.

Kitten heels are short, about 2 inches. They are perfect for office and daily wear.

Tip: If you will wear the shoes for more than 4 hours, choose a block heel or a kitten heel.

title: How to Protect Your Shoes in the Rain
excerpt: Rain can damage your shoes. This quick 5 minute routine keeps them safe.
body:
Before the rain: spray your shoes with a water protector.

If they get wet: wipe them with a soft cloth and stuff them with paper to keep their shape.

Dry them in a shaded, airy place. Never put them in direct sun or near a heater.

When dry, brush or polish them and they are ready again.

title: How to Wear Heels All Night Without Pain
excerpt: Simple tips to enjoy the whole party without sore feet.
body:
Choose the right size. Shoes that are too small or too big cause pain.

Walk in your new shoes at home for a few days before the event.

Use a soft gel insole for extra cushion.

Take short breaks and sit down when you can.

Choose shoes with a cushioned sole. All RAWAN heels are made with extra padding for long wear.
